Priority: P1
Created by: weave strand
issue.notes:
Implemented atomic-publication semantics for the three-object S3 output (commits 800f446 + merge 5d10be8, on main, pushed).

Code (src/): (1) generation_id = <generated_at>-<12 hex chars> minted per cycle and stamped into all three objects -- meta.json as a top-level field, workflows.parquet and runs.parquet as file-level Parquet KV metadata (key generation_id) via new parquet_io.stamp_generation/table_to_parquet_bytes(generation_id=)/read_generation_id. Random suffix makes same-second cycles distinct generations; id lives in the file footer so empty snapshots are pairable too, and conform() drops the stored id so a read-back can never leak an old id into a new publication. Write ordering restructured into read -> compute -> publish: ledger download and payload encoding happen before the first PUT (failures there leave storage untouched), meta.json last as the commit marker, mid-publish abort logged with what landed and what stayed on the old generation, repaired by the next cycle republishing all three under a fresh id. Retries documented at both layers: pinned boto3 standard-mode/10-attempt per request, whole-cycle retry per interval.
